content.text: All preferred elements are satisfied by §§ 18.1–18.2; no redline needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 meets the preferred position in full: CGL at USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional E&O at USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5,000,000 (granted unconditionally rather than only where Vendor processes Customer Data, which is broader in our favour), and workers' compensation as required by law. Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request, plus additional Customer-favourable terms (primacy, cancellation notice, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities). No fallback analysis is needed and no redline is warranted.
